args.summary:
Completed a 2D spine-beam model of the four-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete box girder bridge (32+45+45+32 m, deck 12.5 m).

Key modeling decisions:
- Idealization: spine_beam_2d, system = continuous_on_piers (MR-01, MR-05). Pier columns modeled per given geometry (MR-06); fixed at base, twin Ø1.4 m C40 columns merged into a single column.
- Girder cross-section (cast_box, integrated): A = 6.885 m², I = 4.559 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (C50, JTG3362-3.1.5). γ = 26.5 kN/m³ per owner requirement (MR-00 override); w = 182.45 kN/m, m = 18.60 t/m (MR-07).
- Bearings simulated as zero-length springs (MR-03/MR-04): abutments 0 & 4 (400×500, 5 layers) and piers 1 & 3 (550×650, 6 layers) are PTFE sliding (longitudinal free, Kh = 0, Kv = 3.14×10⁶ / 7.18×10⁶ kN/m); pier 2 (600×700, 7 layers) is plain elastomeric fixed in longitudinal direction (Kh = 10909 kN/m, Kv = 8.03×10⁶ kN/m). All rotations free; 2 bearings per line.
- Pier properties: A = 3.079 m², I = 0.3771 m⁴; lengths 6 / 10 / 19 m; Ec = 32500 MPa (C40).
- Live load: Highway Class I one-way, 3 lanes (JTG D60-2015 4.3.1), qk = 10.5 kN/m, Pk = 324 kN (32 m spans) and 350 kN (45 m spans), transverse reduction ξ = 0.78.

Results (all L1/L2/L3 checks passed):
- Fundamental vertical frequency f1 = 2.686 Hz → impact factor μ = 0.1589 (JTG D60-4.3.2).
- Self-weight support reactions: 2076 / 7739 / 8476 / 7721 / 2086 kN (abutment–abutment).
- Self-weight mid-span moments: 9858 / 16287 / 16450 / 10022 kN·m; support moments −26991 / −32802 / −26664 kN·m.
- Lane max positive moment 11420 kN·m, max negative moment −9501 kN·m.
